BrochureContent.Content:
Jeremy Murphy & Associates are delighted to bring to the market No. 50 Yewlands which is an exceptional four-bedroom semi-detached residence that has been beautifully extended to the rear, creating an outstanding family home with an abundance of bright, spacious, and versatile living accommodation. Designed with modern family living in mind, this superb property seamlessly combines comfort and practicality, offering generous proportions throughout.

One of the home's standout features is its enviable south-facing rear garden, a wonderful sun-filled space that enjoys sunshine throughout the day. Whether relaxing with family, entertaining guests, or dining al fresco on warm summer evenings, this private outdoor area provides the perfect extension to the living space. To the front, the property benefits from private off-street parking, adding further convenience to this home.

Maryborough Woods is widely regarded as one of Douglas' premier residential developments, celebrated for its mature tree-lined surroundings, peaceful atmosphere, and exceptional sense of community. The location is second to none, offering the perfect balance of suburban tranquility and urban convenience. Douglas Village is just minutes away, providing an extensive range of amenities including Douglas Court and Douglas Village Shopping Centres, supermarkets, boutique shops, cafés, award-winning restaurants, bars, pharmacies, gyms, and a host of everyday services.

Families are exceptionally well catered for, with an excellent selection of highly regarded primary and secondary schools nearby, together with a wealth of sporting and recreational facilities including golf clubs, GAA clubs, tennis clubs, fitness centres, and scenic walking routes. Nature lovers will also appreciate the nearby wooded walks and parklands, while Cork City Centre, Cork Airport, Cork University Hospital, Mahon Point Shopping Centre, and the Ringaskiddy business hub are all easily accessible via excellent road networks and regular public transport services.

Combining an enviable address, substantial extended accommodation, a sun-drenched south-facing garden, and unrivalled convenience, No. 50 Yewlands represents a rare opportunity to acquire a lovely family home in one of Cork's most desirable residential locations. This is a property that offers an outstanding lifestyle, where space, quality, and location come together to create a home of enduring appeal.
FRONT OF PROPERTY
To the front there is a driveway with off-street parking. There is also a side entrance which leads to the rear garden.

ENTRANCE HALLWAY          	  1.88m x 5.26m
A solid timber door leads into the entrance hallway. The entrance hallway comprises of tiled flooring, one centre light and one radiator.

LIVING ROOM 		              5.94m x 3.46m
This bright and spacious living room has carpet flooring, one centre light, one radiator and one large window overlooking the front of the property. The living room also has a feature Henley stove with a stunning surround.

KITCHEN	 	                         5.05 m x 3.00m
This kitchen benefits from tiled flooring, one centre light and spotlighting, one radiator, double doors that lead out to the rear garden and one window overlooking the side of the property. The kitchen incorporates a stainless-steel sink with a draining board, space for a fridge/freezer, an integrated dishwasher and an integrated oven.

DINING/LIVING AREA     	  5.17m x 2.39m
Accessed off the kitchen, this area comprises of timber effect laminate flooring, two windows overlooking the rear garden, one centre light, one Velux window and two radiators. The dining area can comfortably facilitate a dining table and four to six chairs.

LOUNGE 		                          2.52m x 4.18m
There is timber flooring, spotlighting and one radiator. This room overlooks the dining/living area.

UTILITY ROOM 		              1.66m x 1.98m
There is tiled flooring, one centre light and a pvc door with frosted glass that leads to the side of the property. There is also plumbing for a washing machine and space for a dryer.

GUEST WC 			              1.83m x 0.77m
There is tiled flooring, one wash hand basin and a wc. The guest wc also incorporates one centre light and one window overlooking the side.
STAIRS & LANDING                      1.89m x 4.00m
The stairs are carpeted and landing area has solid timber flooring. Via the landing there is one centre light, one window overlooking the side access to the hot-press.

MASTER BEDROOM                     3.00m x 4.45m
This double bedroom features solid timber flooring, spotlighting, one radiator and two windows overlooking the front. 

ENSUITE 			            1.43m x 1.75m
There are tiled flooring and walls, a shower, one wash hand basin and a wc. The ensuite also incorporates one centre light, one extractor fan and one radiator.

BEDROOM 2 			2.87m x 3.59m
This double bedroom features solid timber flooring, one centre light, one radiator and one window overlooking the rear. 

BEDROOM 3			2.66m x 2.36m
This double bedroom features solid timber flooring, spotlighting, one radiator and one window overlooking the front. 

BEDROOM 4			2.64m x 2.46m
This bedroom features solid timber flooring, one centre light, one radiator and one window overlooking the rear. 

MAIN BATHROOM 		2.02m x 1.78m
Three-piece bathroom suite incorporating a shower, one wash hand basin and wc. The main bathroom has tiled floors and walls, one centre light, one radiator and one extractor fan. There is access to the attic via stira stairs.

REAR OF PROPERTY
To the rear there is a spacious south-facing garden which has low maintenance. There is side access along with a shed located to the rear. This lovely garden would be an ideal place for entertaining during the summer months.

Exceptional four-bedroom semi-detached family home
Beautifully extended to the rear, providing spacious and versatile accommodation
Located in the highly sought-after Maryborough Woods, Douglas, Cork
Extended dining/living area overlooking the garden
Close proximity to Douglas Village and Douglas Court Shopping Centre
xcellent choice of nearby schools, sporting facilities, parks, and walking routes
